shared_elements: registers or divided zones of imagery
animal(s) (quadruped in A; none clear in B)
justification: Both surfaces show small profile human figures in low relief associated with rectilinear built structures divided into zones, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A is dominated by a symmetrical field of interlaced ribbon-animal ornament under a canopy-like frame with a horse-like quadruped, whereas B is a narrative siege scene with archers, a wheeled ram and towered walls; the compositional logic (abstract symmetry versus horizontal action narrative) is entirely different.
